headline: The US is banning foreign robots
summary: US government targets China with a new import ban. Ban includes "advanced robotic devices" and power inverters. Mobile robots like humanoids and quadrupeds are specifically mentioned.

headline: Ariana Grande is suing hackers over leaked songs and videos
summary: Ariana Grande filed a lawsuit against unidentified hackers. Hackers allegedly stole and leaked private content for years. The suit aims to uncover the identities of the culprits.

headline: Wikimedia Foundation union drive expands to US staff
summary: UK staff at Wikimedia Foundation announced union intentions in June. US-based employees are now joining the union drive. Management has declined to voluntarily recognize the US union.

headline: eBay settles cyberstalking saga for $56 million
summary: eBay and former executives will pay $55.7 million in a settlement. A Massachusetts couple was targeted with a bizarre harassment campaign. Former eBay executives sent live insects and a bloody pig mask.

headline: LAST SENTINEL Delayed as Lightspeed LA Shifts Game’s Creative Direction
summary: Lightspeed LA is making a significant shift in LAST SENTINEL's creative direction. The game's development will be impacted by these changes. Some staff members may be affected by the shift.

headline: Director Destin Daniel Cretton was 'sad' about Avengers: Kang Dynasty cancellation
summary: Spider-Man director Destin Daniel Cretton expressed disappointment. He was sad over the cancellation of Avengers: Kang Dynasty. Marvel's original buildup for Kang the Conqueror did not materialize.

headline: Philips Electric Razor Deals: Save up to 60% at Amazon UK
summary: Amazon UK offers up to 60% off Philips electric shavers. Discounts include Shaver Series 5000 and Series 3000X. OneBlade accessories are also available at reduced prices.

headline: Godzilla Minus One 4K Steelbook Preorders Are Live Now
summary: Preorders for the Godzilla Minus One Limited Edition 4K Steelbook are open. Available on Amazon and Gruv. Secure your 3-disc collector's set before the October release.

headline: Polanski says guillotine re-post was a mistake, refuses to apologize
summary: The Green leader re-posted a photo showing a guillotine t-shirt. The t-shirt featured the name "Nigel." Polanski acknowledged the re-post was a mistake but declined to apologize.

headline: Burnham invites Tories and Lib Dems to social care talks
summary: The PM is expected to speak on finding common ground for social care. Burnham is inviting opposing parties for discussions. Cross-party collaboration is seen as key to fixing social care.

headline: Evidence shows today's 20-somethings face tougher start
summary: Analysis suggests 20-somethings face a tougher start to adulthood. This generation is struggling more than any in almost half a century. The BBC-commissioned analysis highlights the challenges.

headline: Iran and US trade strikes, shattering brief lull
summary: US Central Command intercepted "multiple" ballistic missiles. Missiles were fired by Iran. The exchange shatters a previously brief lull in fighting.
